user.title: Connect to a Server Buddy hub
user.description: Enter the hub's IP address or hostname. The hub uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate that Home Assistant pins after setup.

claim.title: Claim hub {hub_id}
claim.description:
Hub {hub_id} at {host} has not been claimed. Home Assistant will become its only controller and store a new credential. Any device on the local network can claim an unclaimed hub, so only continue on a trusted network.

Certificate fingerprint (SHA-256): `{fingerprint}`

token.title: Authenticate hub {hub_id}
token.description:
This hub is already claimed. Enter its existing credential, or erase the credential on the hub (development recovery) and claim it again.

Certificate fingerprint (SHA-256): `{fingerprint}`

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect hub {hub_id}
reauth_confirm.description: The hub rejected Home Assistant's credential or presented a different certificate. Continue to check the hub again.

certificate_changed.title: Hub {hub_id} certificate changed
certificate_changed.description:
The hub now presents a different TLS certificate. This is expected only after its API storage was erased. If you did not reset the hub, another device may be impersonating it: cancel.

Previously trusted: `{old}`

Now presented: `{new}`

Continue only if the new fingerprint matches the one in the hub's serial log.

error.certificate_changed: The hub's certificate changed during setup. Start again.
error.hub_busy: Another client is connected to the hub. Disconnect it and try again.
error.unsupported_api: This hub uses an unsupported API version.
error.wrong_hub: A different Server Buddy hub answered at this address.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported Server Buddy hub.
abort.unsupported_api: This hub uses an unsupported API version.
abort.wrong_hub: A different Server Buddy hub answered at this address.
abort.certificate_changed: The hub's certificate changed during setup. Start again.

add_node.title: Add a node
add_node.description: The hub creates a node slot and a one-time node key, then opens a pairing window.

node_key.title: Node key for slot {slot}
node_key.description:
Put this key in the node's ESPHome secrets.yaml. It is shown only once and is not stored in Home Assistant:

`{key}`

The pairing window stays open for {seconds} seconds; use "Pair or re-pair a node" to reopen it.

pair_node.title: Pair a node
pair_node.description: Opens a pairing window for the selected node only.

remove_node.title: Remove a node
remove_node.description: Deletes the node and its key from the hub. The node must be re-added and reflashed to rejoin.

error.hub_full: The hub already has the maximum of 17 nodes.

abort.not_loaded: The hub must be connected to manage nodes.
abort.pairing_started: Pairing window opened. Power on or reset the node now.
abort.node_removed: The node was removed from the hub.

unsupported_api.title: Unsupported Server Buddy hub API
unsupported_api.description: Hub {hub_id} reports API {api}, but this integration supports {supported}. Update the integration or the hub firmware so they match.
